negative_defect_families: compound condition compressed to one operand
participant substituted for implicit constrained state

fairness_validation.future_call_projection: Use only predicate_contracts plus each case's blind_id, grounded assertion statement/participants/evidence, symbols, and candidate source/predicate/target tuple; sort by blind_id. Exclude candidate ID, statement, confidence, and origin as well as all gold, diagnostic, and provenance fields.

limitations: Ten cases support only a bounded exploratory comparison.
Two negative cases share the same tunneling source passage and are correlated.
Three negative cases and two positive controls come from the same frozen quantum source.
The older SPEC-003 positive reviews are explicit domain-level regression findings rather than item-shaped review records.
Sources and artifact schemas are historically heterogeneous and English-only.
The packet cannot justify a production admission threshold or broad domain generalization without additional independently reviewed realistic-source evidence.
